RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST1.title: Rainbow Dash Plush
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST1.description: Whenever you play a card created during combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] Block.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST2.title: Badge
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST2.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PreparationPower}[/blue] Charge and [blue]{FlightPower}[/blue] Flight.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST3.title: Element of Loyalty
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST3.description: Whenever you lose HP in combat, gain [blue]{FlightPower}[/blue] Flight.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST4.title: Adventure Novel
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST4.description: At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Daring Do card[/gold] into your Hand.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST5.title: Electric Guitar
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST5.description: Whenever you gain Charge, gain [blue]{PreparationPower}[/blue] more Charge.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST6.title: Ten Seconds Flat!
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST6.description:
At the end of combat, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] Gold.
Each turn you end reduces the Gold this Relic grants this combat by [blue]{GoldReduction}[/blue], to a minimum of 0.
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST7.title: Bottled Rainbow
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST7.description:
Upon pickup, choose 1 of {Cards} cards of any color.
At the start of each combat, add that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
RD_MOD_RELIC_TEST7.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card, or confirm without selecting one to skip.
